scope: Hunucmá 2011 apparent visible water/sand reference only; 12 panels and 26 native context checks
limitations: 8 m is an operational visual interpretation tolerance, not a standard deviation, geolocation accuracy or field validation.
Raw z17 pixels were displayed at .5 m/display pixel in the strips; oversampling does not create .5 m native precision.
Foam and wet sand make a several-metre transition; no tide, beach-slope, wave or inter-year registration correction is certified.
The dates/sensors are checked against individually cached official endpoint metadata, not inferred from publication year or adjacent pixels.
The 227 remaining municipality profiles without a dated 2011 photograph are outside this 157-profile visual sample.
Other years have not been independently visually approved by this review.
review_method: Viewed all 12 full manual panels; then all 12 raw strips normalized about each proposed point, with ticks kept at strip sides.
Compared 26 selected profiles in raw native north-up mosaic contexts, including all six problematic positions and the four pending inlet profiles.
Rejected three points that remained in open water; requested three conservative refinements in diffuse swash bands.
Checked current annotation rows, offsets, source panel hashes and each of 153 corrected endpoint date/sensor metadata hashes.
